I've graded submission s1 for quiz 0001 and written the grades to `grades/0001-s1.json`. The reviewer subagent found nothing to change in the first draft, so one review pass was enough.

| Item | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | wrong | You chose (a), that the model opens the booking system itself. |
| q3 | correct | A step limit is the right safeguard against the repeated failing edit. |
| q4 | wrong | You answered 1, with the model running the three tools in one call. The answer is 4. |
| q5 | partial | The result goes back to the model, but you didn't say why. |
| q6 | partial | The tool descriptions part is right, but the model doesn't remember past picks across sessions. |

You have the loop (q1), the need for a stopping condition (q3) and how the model finds a tool from its description (q6, first half).

**The idea to work on:** the belief that the model runs the tools itself (q2, q4). The model only writes a request, and the program runs the tool and calls the model again.

**Next step:** trace "Is the laser cutter free tomorrow?" on paper as two columns, "model outputs" and "program does". Mark where each model call begins and ends.

I also wrote `review-records/0001-s1-grade.md`, a new learning record (`learning-records/0003-model-requests-program-runs-open.md`) and an update to `NOTES.md`. `submissions/s2.json` is still ungraded.
